run_train_eval_runner: create a TrainEvalRunner with train and eval dataloaders then call run to start training
create_checkpoint_callback: create a TrainCheckpointCallback that saves checkpoints every N steps during training
find_recent_checkpoint: call get_most_recent_viable_checkpoint_path to find the latest checkpoint directory with metadata
save_training_state: call save_state on TrainEvalRunner to persist the training unit state to a checkpoint path
load_training_state: call load_state on TrainEvalRunner to restore training from a checkpoint or the most recent one
